title: Review of Consumer Protection (Fair Trading) Act to Prohibit Greenwashing by Businesses
what_it_is: Review of Consumer Protection (Fair Trading) Act to Prohibit Greenwashing by Businesses

sections.label: Consumer protection against greenwashing
sections.summary: The CPFTA protects consumers from false or misleading claims, and CCCS and CASE developed tips and are developing guidelines on environmental claims.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: The Consumer Protection (Fair Trading) Act, or CPFTA, already protects consumers against businesses that make false or misleading claims about their products or services, including around greenwashing.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: In November 2023, the Competition and Consumer Commission of Singapore (CCCS) and the Consumers Association of Singapore (CASE) jointly developed a set of tips to help consumers better understand environmental claims made by suppliers or businesses.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: The CCCS is also developing a set of guidelines to help businesses make more accurate environmental claims about their products and services.

sections.label: Guidelines and reporting environmental claims
sections.summary: CCCS will seek public feedback on guidelines for suppliers' environmental claims, and consumers may report misleading advertisements to ASAS.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: The second upstream measure is also to develop these guidelines to better guide on the supplier side, to better guide suppliers on environmental claims that could amount to unfair practices, which are covered under the Act, the CCCS will seek public feedback on this in due course.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: So, we welcome the Member and also other Members to provide their feedback and suggestions on this.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: But, in general, we do advise suppliers to be very specific and accurate in their environmental claims and to ensure that all of these claims can be substantiated with credible evidence.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: If there are egregious cases, where the business persistently engages in these unfair practices, CASE then can refer these to CCCS for further investigation.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: On the other hand also, you might encounter some advertising which would be concerning.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: So, consumers may also report suppliers' advertisements which contain these potentially misleading or false environmental claims to the Advertising Standards Authority of Singapore (ASAS).

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: ASAS administers the Singapore Code of Advertising Practice (SCAP), and if the advertisement is objectionable under SCAP, ASAS may ask the advertiser to either men or to withdraw the advertisement altogether.
